rate_snapshot.basis: Peak rates, used conservatively even off-peak. Recheck before changing models or prices.

failure_policy: Reject over-budget/context requests locally; do not retry transport errors, empty content or truncated output. Missing usage retains the full reservation.
statistics: Report both cost per attempted slot and total generation cost / admitted targets. Never treat a budget rejection as algorithmic zero coverage.
comparability: Apply the same model, thinking mode, output limit and money limit to all LLM arms. Keep older high-thinking measurements in their original batch.
